title: Business Spaces directory cards wear the Frequency Founding mark on the photo, not a text tag
detail: Follow-on to LIVE-1019 (design item 8). The directory card in FqSpacesBody drew the Founding status as a line of body text. It now draws the same FounderMark pill the Space page cover uses, in the photo's bottom-left corner (the kind tag keeps the top-left), and the body line keeps only Boosted. The Founding Businesses row is unchanged. Status only, no rate. No migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const s=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/spaces/spaces-body.tsx','utf8');if(!s.includes('<FounderMark'))bad.push('directory card does not draw the Frequency Founding mark');if(s.includes(\"'Founding Business'\"))bad.push('card still prints the old text tag');if(!fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-b.css','utf8').includes('.fqm-corner-b'))bad.push('sheet lost the corner slot');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1040: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a directory card stops drawing the mark or goes back to the text tag.
